title: Join Bright Futures 4 All Holiday Clubs | London Events for Kids
text:
Join the Club

Learning Made Fun and Easy!

Our Holiday Club is the perfect place for kids to have fun and learn during their school break.

Sports & Science Holiday Clubs / Free School Meals

Since 2019, we have delivered a variety of exciting activities: arts & crafts, science experiments, sports, food science, building games, and access to a sensory & nurture room. Our holiday clubs are free for students eligible for Free School Meals (FSM). This initiative supports the development of resilience, character & well being in families.

Better health & nutrition

International Summer School

This London based international youth exchange programme, took place for 10 years (2009-2019), for one week, each summer. Danish teenagers (Koge Youth Centre, Denmark), supported by British student ambassadors, spent their mornings in Central London, learning English language, history & culture, Afternoons were spent touring London’s iconic landmarks & places of interest (museums, galleries and libraries). Both student groups bonded, whilst sharing cultural conversations on hobbies, interests & popular culture (music, film, literature & art). To organise a programme contact us.

The holiday club was great fun. Everyone worked hard as a team and tried their hardest to accommodate each others needs!

The staff were very helpful in both understanding his needs and supporting his access to the provision. This is the first time my son has been able to participate in a holiday club. Thank you so much for your hard work in making it inclusive.
